name: Tenjiku Botan
source:
A busty, quintessential subculture college girl.

Determined to elevate her own social value, she eagerly starts DMing the protagonist after he debuts as a rookie light novel author, hoping to work her way up to meeting him in person.

She runs a modestly popular social media account.
At first glance, it seems to have grown thanks to her recommendations of obscure novels and cult films—but in reality, she's exceptionally good at weaving carefully chosen selfies into her feed.

She's that kind of calculating little fox.
Naturally, at the otaku club, she's the type who casually ends up sitting on some nerdy guy's lap.

Ever since seeing Girl with a Pearl Earring, she fell in love with the world of fine art. Deep down, she secretly dreams of one day becoming a woman as perfectly complete—as much a work of art—as the girl in that painting.

...Whether that's truly possible, however, is another matter entirely.

[From [url=https://x.com/__your_sister__/status/2076026923294298418]official profile[/url]]
